name: Love, I Imagine
source:
Arty, a bird with a passion for the paranormal, is the host of a horror podcast with stagnating views. Even his sweet boyfriend (and co-host) Max doesn't seem to be into it. Desperate for a way to kill two birds with one stone (so to speak), Arty leaps at the chance to play real-life investigator when a viewer asks for help with a supernatural problem.

Max is skeptical. But Arty's determined to prove him wrong and open his mind. Is the case a mere figment of a lonely imagination? Or has their client found himself the target of something sinister, a malevolent force that wants him mind, body, and soul?

Will Max and Arty's first case be their last? 

[From [url=https://gayohell.itch.io/love-i-imagine]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Arty是一只对超自然现象充满热情的鸟，是一个观点停滞的恐怖播客的主持人。甚至他可爱的男朋友（兼共同主持人）麦克斯似乎也不喜欢它。当观众寻求帮助解决超自然问题时，Arty迫切希望找到一种一石二鸟的方法（可以这么说），他抓住了扮演现实生活中的调查员的机会。

麦克斯对此表示怀疑。但阿蒂决心证明他是错的，并打开他的心扉。这个案子只是一个孤独的想象的虚构吗？或者他们的客户是否发现自己成为某种邪恶势力的目标，一股恶毒的力量想要他的思想、身体和灵魂？

马克斯和阿蒂的第一个案件会是他们的最后一个案件吗？

[来自[url=https://gayohell.itch.io/love-i-imagine]Itch.io[/url]]
